audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 7 fabric identification by feel, look, weight, and garment use.
audio_prompts.script: Look at the four fabric swatches. Number one: This fabric is white, soft, and lightweight. It feels smooth and comfortable. It is good for shirts and summer dresses. Number two: This fabric is blue, heavy, and structured. It feels thick and strong. It is good for jeans and jackets. Number three: This fabric is smooth and shiny. It is light and elegant. It is good for blouses or dresses. Number four: This fabric is black and textured. It looks sheer and decorative. It is good for sleeves, details, or accessories.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each numbered description.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
